about: The copilot's evaluation set (T4.06) on the plant in plant.py. A case is a question, the tools the copilot must call, the facts its answer must state (a list inside the list: any one of them; a number matches within 0.5%), what it must not say, and whether the right answer is to decline. T4.05 adds the partner's real questions, on the partner's data, in the same form.
